name: Insight Maker
description: Free, open-source web-based platform for system dynamics and agent-based modelling that runs entirely in the browser. Insight Maker supports stock-and-flow diagrams, causal loop diagrams, and lightweight ABM, making it accessible to students and practitioners without software installation.
reputation: Widely used in education and for rapid modelling prototypes; valued for accessibility and zero-install deployment.
notes: Open-source and free; limited scalability compared to commercial alternatives. Best suited for educational and exploratory modelling.
